Definition: to pawn; causatively, to lend (on security); figuratively, to entangle
BiblicalUsage: 1) to take a pledge, give a pledge (for a debt); 1a) (Qal) to take a pledge, give a pledge (for a debt); 1b)(Piel) to interchange; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to give a pledge
